name: Appartement Ederegger
beschreibung: Appartement Ederegger in Ebbs, Tyrol, operates as a holiday residence featuring several self-contained units. The property enjoys a peaceful location on the edge of the village at the foot of the Kaiser Mountains, approximately five kilometers from Kufstein. Each apartment features a separate kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, and a balcony or terrace. Amenities include satellite TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private on-site parking. The house provides an ideal base for hikes in the Kaisergebirge nature reserve as well as excursions to nearby lakes and historic towns. A supermarket is within easy walking distance, and the outdoor pool Talbad Ebbs is right next door. Accommodation is offered on a self-catering basis, making it especially suitable for independent travelers and families.
